Anika (CEO): Quick follow-up to questions from today's AH Q&A. Recording + deck: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23-extras (org-only). Dropping clarifications and owners so we close outstanding asks. :spiral_calendar:

Priya (VP Product): Two asks from the chat: 1) Is there a single-runbook for migrating routes to Dedicated? 2) Who owns the external-facing FAQ?

Devon (CTO): Short answers: 1) We'll publish a consolidated runbook (infra + product checklist). 2) Product will own FAQ, Solutions will own the partner-facing version.

Joel (Ops): I'll assemble the runbook sections: infra prep, cutover checklist, rollback steps, post-migration verification. Will link a draft repo by EOD 2026-03-27.

Mei (Design): For the FAQ, I'd like to create a tiny visual one-pager and an interactive Console tooltip for common migration steps. Can Product share copy by 2026-03-29?

Priya (VP Product): Yes. I'll draft the FAQ copy + migration timeline; Mei can design the one-pager. Also: confirm pilot customers get Optimize early access and concierge onboarding.

Anika (CEO): Confirmed on pilot benefits (Optimize early access + concierge onboarding + billing credits). SLA begins at GA (2026-06-01) per earlier note.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "AH followups: migration runbook & FAQ sync" 1926-03-30 10:00 PST 1https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1943210000

Action items (compact):
- Joel (Ops) -> publish runbook draft (repo + link) due 2026-03-27 (#JIRA-4100)
- Priya (VP Product) -> FAQ copy + migration timeline due 2026-03-29 (#JIRA-4101)
- Mei (Design) -> one-pager + Console tooltip mockups due 2026-04-02 (#JIRA-4102)
- Devon (CTO) -> review runbook and add infra verification tests by 2026-04-05 (#JIRA-4103)
- Anika (CEO) -> check progress in leadership sync on 2026-03-30

Priya (VP Product): Also, small ask: Sales asked for a short snippet about billing (pilot credits). Raj, please coordinate on exact credit amounts and I'll add wording.

Devon (CTO): I'll add a quick tech note about default retry/backoff and a YAML example for route policies to the runbook.

Anika (CEO): If anyone sees blockers, flag here by 2026-03-25 so we can reassign. Thanks team  good momentum. :rocket:
